name: Creamy tomato pasta
blurb: Pantry pasta that tastes like a hug
details: Penne, canned tomatoes, garlic, a splash of cream and lots of parmesan.
steps: Boil the penne in well-salted water until just tender. Save a cup of the pasta water.
While it cooks, warm the olive oil and garlic in a big pan for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and pepper flakes and simmer for 8 minutes.
Stir in the cream and parmesan.
Toss in the pasta with a splash of pasta water until glossy. Season and serve.

name: Sheet-pan fajitas
blurb: One pan, zero fuss, big sizzle
details: Chicken, peppers and onions roasted hot with chili and cumin. Wrap in warm tortillas.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Slice the chicken, peppers and onion into strips.
Toss everything on a sheet pan with the oil, chili powder, cumin and a big pinch of salt.
Roast for 18 to 20 minutes, until the chicken is cooked and the edges char.
Warm the tortillas, squeeze lime over the pan, and wrap it up with sour cream.

name: Teriyaki salmon bowls
details: Pan-seared salmon, quick teriyaki glaze, rice, cucumber and sesame.
steps: Cook the rice.
Stir together the soy sauce, honey and ginger.
Sear the salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, flip, and cook 3 more.
Pour in the sauce and let it bubble for 1 minute, spooning it over the fish.
Slice the cucumber and scallions. Build bowls of rice, salmon and cucumber, then top with sesame and scallions.

name: Grilled cheese and tomato soup
details: Crispy buttered sourdough with cheddar, dunked in a quick tomato soup.
steps: Simmer the tomatoes, broth and sugar for 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Butter the outsides of the bread and fill with cheddar.
Cook the sandwiches in a pan over medium heat, about 3 minutes per side, until golden and melty.
Blend the soup if you like it smooth.
Cut the sandwiches into strips and dunk.

name: Shrimp tacos with slaw
details: Garlicky shrimp, lime cabbage slaw and a spoon of chipotle mayo.
steps: Toss the cabbage with the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt.
Stir the chipotle into the mayo.
Sauté the garlic and shrimp in a hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes, until pink.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with slaw and shrimp, add a spoon of chipotle mayo, cilantro and a lime wedge.

name: Spicy peanut noodles
details: Noodles tossed in peanut butter, soy, lime and chili crisp. Top with scallions.
steps: Cook the noodles. Save a little of the cooking water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, chili crisp and honey with a few spoons of hot water until smooth.
Toss the noodles in the sauce.
Top with sliced scallions and chopped peanuts.

name: Greek chicken salad
details: Lemon-oregano chicken, cucumber, tomato, olives, feta and warm pita.
steps: Toss the chicken with lemon juice, oregano, olive oil and salt. Let it sit for 5 minutes.
Cook in a hot pan for 5 to 6 minutes per side.
Chop the cucumber and halve the tomatoes.
Slice the chicken over the vegetables with olives and crumbled feta.
Warm the pita and serve on the side.
